definitions.explanation: An act that was attempted but not completed or not successful, especially a crime. In legal usage, it refers to a criminal attempt where the intended result was not achieved. Used as a noun or as a の-adjective modifier.

examples.japanese: ⟦{殺人|さつじん}→殺人：13236_satsujin⟧{未遂|みすい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was arrested for attempted murder.

examples.japanese: ⟦{強盗|ごうとう}→強盗：02818_goutou⟧{未遂|みすい}⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}した→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。

⟦{犯行|はんこう}→犯行：13472_hankou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{未遂|みすい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}→容疑者：15039_yougisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{未遂|みすい}{罪|ざい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{起訴|きそ}→起訴：10577_kiso⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The crime ended as an attempt, but the suspect was charged with an attempted offense.

notes:
USAGE:
{未遂|みすい} is used primarily in legal and news contexts. It attaches to crime names as a suffix: ⟦{殺人|さつじん}→殺人：13236_satsujin⟧{未遂|みすい} (attempted murder), ⟦{強盗|ごうとう}→強盗：02818_goutou⟧{未遂|みすい} (attempted robbery).

The phrase {未遂|みすい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わる (to end as an attempt / to fail) describes an action that was attempted but ultimately unsuccessful.

In Japanese criminal law, {未遂|みすい}{罪|ざい} (attempted crime) is treated differently from ⟦{既遂|きすい}→既遂：23639_kisui⟧ (completed crime) in sentencing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{殺人|さつじん}→殺人：13236_satsujin⟧{未遂|みすい}: attempted murder
- ⟦{強盗|ごうとう}→強盗：02818_goutou⟧{未遂|みすい}: attempted robbery
- {未遂|みすい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わる: to end as an attempt
- {未遂|みすい}{罪|ざい}: attempted crime (legal term)
